the same thing this registry enforces: presence in this ledger is
discovery/reference evidence only, never a legal determination.
Every rights object below is legalReviewState=UNREVIEWED with every
permission boolean false, per P0.G3's explicit instruction: seed only
provenance, never fake permissions. noAiRestriction defaults to true
for every UNREVIEWED entry -- a deliberate fail-closed choice, not a
claim that a No-AI clause was found: the true value is unknown, and
this flag only ever ADDS restriction, never grants it, so assuming
the more restrictive reading costs nothing while the record is
unreviewed. See P0_G3_RIGHTS_GOVERNANCE.md for the full rationale.
DISTRIBUTOR and REFURBISHED_USED are real sourceClass values (see the
schema) but have no seeded entry here: the source-strategy document
names the CLASS ('official distributors', 'refurbished/used
inventories') without a specific canonical URL, and this registry does
not invent one. Seed a real entry once a specific distributor is
actually identified.
Validate with: python -m pytest scripts/equipment_identity/test_rights.py -q
